dedupe_keys.name: cmdpc obb a large scale image dataset for coal mine drill pipe counting based on oriented bounding box

description: CMDPC_OBB: A Large-Scale Image Dataset for Coal Mine Drill Pipe Counting based on Oriented Bounding Box is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Fukai Zhang et al. To address the scarcity of publicly available underground coal mine monitoring image datasets and the challenges of accurate recognition under complex drilling environments, this study constructs a large-scale image dataset for coal mine drill pipe counting based on Oriented Bounding Boxes (CMDPC_OBB). Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: TXT, XML, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 33706544257 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
